label: Flux Schnell
description: Black Forest Labs Flux Schnell. Fast, low-cost image generation for drafts, previews, and iteration.

llm_instructions.writing_guide:
Flux Schnell is the fast, low-cost sibling of Flux Dev — use it for drafts, storyboard previews, and iteration before committing to Flux Dev for finals.

Prompt style is the same as Flux Dev: lead with subject and composition, then lighting, then style. However, Schnell is less sensitive to prompt detail — simpler prompts work fine for drafts.

Negative prompts are NOT supported by Flux Schnell — omit the negative field.

Guidance scale is fixed internally — no parameter to set.

Because Schnell is a draft tool, seed consistency matters more here than in Flux Dev. Set seeds when iterating on a specific shot so you can compare prompt variations against the same base.

Keep prompts under 100 words. Schnell degrades less gracefully with long prompts than Flux Dev does.
